note: Step 2 bridge, Unity side (2026-10-20). Host, port, rates, watchdog and limits come from the shared bridge.json named in paths (Python reads the same file). Protocol: docs/protocol.md.

nav.snap_note: NavMesh.SamplePosition snaps the path start (robot) and the target to the NavMesh within this distance; telemetry reports the horizontal snap distances.
nav.agent_note: AMR agent type (ProjectSettings, created by Nusrat 2026-10-20): radius 0.5 m = half of the 1.00 m required passage width (robot + pallet, footprint.py), height 1.8 m, step height 0.02 m, max slope 5 deg. Its ID is read from the NavMesh Surface with this agent type; Play logs an error if none is baked.

camera_360.centre_note: Confirmed 2026-10-20 in Unity: a cube placed along world +Z appears at the centre of the equirectangular image (ConvertToEquirect puts the cubemap +Z face at the centre).

flip_note: true only if the JPEGs Python saves are upside down (GPU readback row order differs by graphics API).
